title: Exploration and Exploitation Errors Are Measurable for Language Model Agents
abstract: arXiv:2604.13151v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language Model (LM) agents are increasingly used in complex decision-making tasks, from AI coding to physical AI, where they must both explore a search space and exploit acquired knowledge effectively. Although exploration and exploitation play different roles in decision-making, it remains challenging to systematically distinguish exploration and exploitation without access to the agent's internal policy, and to determine when either constitutes an error. To address this, we design partially observable 2D grid maps paired with an unknown symbolic task directed acyclic graph (DAG), abstracting practical agentic AI scenarios. We then propose a policy-agnostic metric that detects unproductive traversals, while permitting necessary backtracking. translated_title: 语言模型智能体的探索与利用错误是可测量的
translated_abstract: 语言模型（LM）智能体日益被应用于复杂的决策任务中，从AI编程到具身物理AI，它们既需要探索搜索空间，又需要有效地利用已获取的知识。尽管探索和利用在决策中扮演着不同的角色，但在无法获取智能体内部策略的情况下，如何系统地区分探索和利用行为仍然具有挑战性，且难以判定二者何时构成了错误。为了解决这个问题，我们设计了部分可观测的2D网格地图，并配以未知的符号化任务有向无环图（DAG），以抽象实际的智能体AI应用场景。随后，我们提出了一种与策略无关的度量方法，用于检测无效的遍历行为，同时允许必要的回溯。我们根据当前状态是否允许有效的探索、有效的利用或两者兼有，将每个错误归因于探索或利用。使用具有可控参数的生成地图和任务DAG进行实验……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种与策略无关的度量方法，在无法访问智能体内部策略的情况下，首次实现了对语言模型智能体探索错误与利用错误的系统性测量与归因。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a policy-agnostic metric that, for the first time, enables systematic measurement and attribution of exploration and exploitation errors in language model agents without access to their internal policies.
